title: 给 Agent 看的 README:上下文文件是基建还是货物崇拜?(深入版) — BigCat Deep Research
title_en: The README for Agents: Are Context Files Infrastructure or Cargo Cult? (Deep Dive) — BigCat Deep Research

questions.question: 关于 AGENTS.md 这类给 agent 看的上下文文件，按文章对第一批对照研究的审计，唯一带统计检验、站得住的效应是什么？
options: LLM 自动生成的文件会显著降低任务成功率
文件越短、指令越靠前，遵从率越高
带文件时任务成功率显著提升
带文件时完成耗时和输出 token 下降
questions.explanation: Codex 配对实验测得中位耗时 -28.64%、输出 token -16.58%，Wilcoxon 检验 p<0.05，是唯一带统计检验的效应。成功率方向三项研究互相矛盾，LLM 生成文件降成功率的数字被方法学审计否决。
questions.question_en: For agent context files like AGENTS.md, after the article's audit of the first controlled studies, what is the only effect backed by a statistical test that holds up?
options_en: LLM-generated files significantly lower success rates
Shorter files with instructions up top get more compliance
Significantly higher task success rates with the file
Lower completion time and fewer output tokens with the file
questions.explanation_en: The paired Codex experiment found median time down 28.64% and output tokens down 16.58% with a Wilcoxon test at p<0.05 — the only effect with a statistical test. On success rates, three studies contradict each other, and the claim that LLM-generated files hurt success was vetoed by the methodology audit.

questions.question: 一项 1,650 次会话的因子实验检验了上下文文件「怎么写」的民间智慧。它发现真正预测 agent 指令遵从率的是什么？
options: 文件的大小，以及指令在文件中的位置
任务类型，以及会话里已经生成了多少内容
单个文件还是多个文件的嵌套结构
指令是否用了 IMPORTANT 这类强调词
questions.explanation: 文件大小、指令位置、单文件还是嵌套、相邻文件矛盾四个结构变量都没有可检测的效应；预测遵从率的是任务类型，以及会话内衰减：每多生成一个函数，遵从几率约降 5.6%。指令在会话里的位置比在文件里的位置重要。
questions.question_en: A factorial experiment over 1,650 sessions tested folk wisdom about how to write context files. What actually predicted the agent's instruction compliance?
options_en: The file's size, and where the instruction sits within the file
The task type, and how much had already been generated in the session
Whether it was a single file or a nested multi-file structure
Whether the instruction used emphasis words like IMPORTANT
questions.explanation_en: None of the four structural variables — size, position, single versus nested files, contradictions in neighboring files — had a detectable effect. Compliance tracked task type and within-session decay: each additional function generated cut the odds by about 5.6%. Where an instruction sits in the session matters more than where it sits in the file.

questions.question: 既然受控实验没找到文件大小对遵从率的效应，文章认为「上下文文件要写短」还有什么可靠理由？
options: 受控实验已证明文件越短，agent 就越听从其中的指令
长上下文会非均匀地退化，每一行都在挤占任务本身的上下文预算
文件越短，就越不容易被人注入恶意指令、成为攻击面
所有主流 agent 都会静默截断超过 200 行的上下文文件
questions.explanation: 文章把「短」的论证换成上下文预算与 context rot：长上下文非均匀退化有多源证实。它明确说「短了 agent 更听话」未获证实；200 行只是 Anthropic 的建议口径，硬截断的是 Codex 的 32 KiB 合计上限。
questions.question_en: Since the controlled experiment found no effect of file size on compliance, what sound reason does the article still give for keeping context files short?
options_en: Controlled experiments have shown that shorter files make agents follow instructions better
Long contexts degrade unevenly, and every line eats into the task's own context budget
Shorter files are harder to inject malicious instructions into, shrinking the attack surface
All major agents silently truncate any context file longer than 200 lines
questions.explanation_en: The article moves the case for brevity onto context budget and context rot: uneven degradation in long contexts is confirmed by multiple sources. It says plainly that 'shorter means more obedient' is unproven; 200 lines is only Anthropic's guidance, and the hard truncation is Codex's 32 KiB combined cap.
